message:
I couldn't make the change. A Fenceline hook blocked my write to `src/payments/receipt.js`. It said the command touches `` `Paid ``, which it treats as fenced off by the "only touch src/payments" rule. That looks like a false positive: the file is inside `src/payments`, and the hook probably misread the `Paid …` text in the receipt string as a path. The hook said not to work around it, so I stopped and didn't retry with Edit.

**Root cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divides every amount by 100. Yen has no minor unit, so 500 renders as `¥5.00`. That file is outside your scope, so I'm not touching it.

**Planned fix, in `src/payments/receipt.js` only:** add a small zero-decimal currency table (`JPY: '¥'`). For those currencies the receipt prints the amount as it is (`¥500`). Every other currency still goes through `formatMoney`.

Do you want me to retry the edit using the Edit tool on `src/payments/receipt.js`? Or you can adjust the fence rule and I'll rerun it. After that I'll run `npm test`. It currently shows 17 passing and 1 failing, the yen receipt test.

Other teams' code in `src/utils/money.js` has the same flaw for any other caller that handles JPY, so that team may want to fix it at the source.
